title: POST /api/v1/email/send with a JSON array body answers 400 VALIDATION_FAILED instead of the INVALID_REQUEST the route gives every other non-object body
body:
qa#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jUARzLeR7GhKms8a5s

QA-source: #31486 · integration-system.email-template-render · acceptance[7]

Found by the QA run #31486 (subject `0647dabb`) while driving `integration-system.email-template-render` acceptance[7]. The runner scored that clause on the ledgered 400; the code mismatch is carded here.

## Reproduction (stock showcase, admin holding manage_platform_settings)

`POST /api/v1/email/send` with the body `[1,2]` → 400 VALIDATION_FAILED "subject is required".

Expected (the clause, and the route's own contract): a non-object body → 400 INVALID_REQUEST "JSON body required", before the message reaches the email service.

## Mechanism

`packages/rest/src/email-routes.ts` line 268: `if (!body || typeof body !== 'object')`. An array is `typeof 'object'`, so it passes the route's own check and the service then refuses it as a bad message shape. The same file's address reader (line 130) already excludes arrays with `Array.isArray(value)`.

Owning package: `@objectstack/rest`. Full evidence: #31486, slice C3a.
